textRuns.value: Default, loss and ROI figures use matured loans only (the full term has ended), so outcomes are final; loans issued from 2016 are mostly still running. Tiles and the map shade each state by default rate; hover a tile for the state tooltip. The ranking shows the 15 worst states (Top N filter). Right-click a state → Drill through → Loan Detail. Bottom right: Pareto of net credit loss. The Application Type filter in the filters pane applies to every page.
